checkpoints.description: [1/3] Plan migration of Coda into the AIKit projects folder

impact_assessment.why: The user directed that new software live under projects/ and be governed by AIKit; the existing copy sits outside the portfolio registry.
impact_assessment.benefits: One registered project with ledger, ADRs and gates; no duplicate source tree; deterministic output preserved.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: keep the 48 passing tests and byte-identical WAV output; dependency: Rust is installed but off PATH and needs the GNU toolchain; concurrency: the workspace has another agent's active cairn-arrays task that must not be touched; state: AIKit scaffold memory in .aikit must be preserved.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Copy source verbatim into the AIKit-created project, keep its .aikit memory, record ADRs via aikit adr, run cargo test and aikit check, never publish or push.

checkpoints.description: [2/3] Migrated Coda source, examples, tests and verifier into projects/coda; recorded four ADRs and AIKit memory
[3/3] AIKit Phase 4 passed: 5/5 gates (hygiene, guidelines, secrets, compat, cargo test); 48 tests green; README and codebase map verified; local-only, no remote
[1/1] Record the README cold-start tree fix

impact_assessment.why: The strict gate found a tracked path missing from the README tree after the migration commit.
impact_assessment.benefits: A cold-starting agent sees every tracked directory.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: README tree must match tracked paths; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: ledger must not trail a completed task.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Record the one-commit doc fix as its own task, pass Phase 4, then complete it.

checkpoints.description: README tree now lists scripts/ and tests/; AIKit phase 4 to be rerun
[1/1] Add a deterministic album manifest alongside generated tracks

impact_assessment.why: Album mode prints digests to stdout but leaves no inspectable record next to the tracks.
impact_assessment.benefits: A seed, settings and digests travel with the WAVs; the output is auditable and reproducible.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: only additive output, no change to WAV bytes or golden vectors; dependency: std only; concurrency: none; state: generated album/ is gitignored.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Write a plain JSON manifest after the tracks, test byte equality across two runs, rerun all AIKit gates.

checkpoints.description: 5/5 AIKit gates passed; 48 tests green; album manifest is deterministic and byte-identical across runs
[1/2] Plan and implement dependency-free Standard MIDI File export

impact_assessment.why: Coda compiles scores to audio but cannot hand them to a DAW or synthesizer; MIDI makes the symbolic score portable without adding a dependency.
impact_assessment.benefits: render/seed can write .mid as well as .wav; the same deterministic score drives both; no crates or external tools.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: WAV bytes and golden vectors must not change; dependency: std only; concurrency: none; state: output routing by file extension must stay explicit in help and README.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add a pure midi.rs encoder with VLQ and byte-vector tests, route by output extension only, run cargo test plus all AIKit gates before commit.

checkpoints.description: 5/5 AIKit gates passed; 56 tests green; MIDI header/VLQ/byte tests and CLI extension routing verified; WAV golden vectors unchanged

impact_assessment.why: A CLI smoke test left scale.mid untracked because .gitignore only covered WAV output.
impact_assessment.benefits: Generated MIDI files no longer dirty the project tree.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: no source change; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: .gitignore only.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add *.mid and *.midi patterns and verify with a clean-tree strict check.

checkpoints.description: Generated MIDI artifacts are gitignored; gates rerun
